pr_title: image/save: Derive Descriptor from actual tar archive
pr_body:
- fixes: https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/47072
- follow up to: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47068

Graphdriver layer size is the sum of the individual files size (like `du -s`), not the tar archive (`tar | wc -c`). The layer descriptor in OCI manifest specifies the byte size of the tar archive. Use the total bytes read returned by `io.Copy` to populate the `Size` field.

Also set the digest to the actual digest of the tar archive.

issue_context.title: [v25 rc.2] `docker save` produces OCI layer descriptors with wrong blob size
issue_context.body:
### Description

In Docker v25.0.0-rc.2, `docker save` produces OCI layer descriptors with wrong blob size

### Reproduce

FROM busybox
RUN touch /hello

$ docker build -t foo .

$ docker save foo | tar x

$ jq . < index.json

review_comments: Whoops, restored. I didn't intend to remove it in this PR (it _could_ be deleted though, but that's out of scope here).

Hm, maybe we _do_ want to remove the saved layers, there is [this test](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/33b5a5813b805aaba28c06ee1a8aa5b1f2435a1d/image/tarexport/save.go#L454) on top, don't we want to test `diffIDDescs` at the beginning and return that desc if it exists? Right now it will return an empty desc for already saved layers
Removed unused maps and refactored the function to better distinguish between saved image (Config) and saved layer (diff tar archive).
